articles.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
articles.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti
articles.titleJa: イエメン人がフーシ派とサウジ支援勢力の戦争激化で紅海を渡り避難
articles.summary: 戦争が激化するイエメンから、多くの人々が紅海を渡りジブチへ避難している状況を伝える。

articles.title: Merz vows to keep coalition together for Germany's 'democratic future'
articles.description: The chancellor has come under increasing pressure after resounding state election defeats, but says the results "go far beyond my own person"
articles.titleJa: メルツ氏、ドイツの「民主的未来」のため連立維持を誓う
articles.summary: 州議会選挙での敗北後、圧力を受ける首相が、ドイツの民主的未来のために連立を維持すると誓った。

articles.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
articles.description: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.
articles.titleJa: CNN、MS NOW、Politicoがトランプ氏のホワイトハウス出入り禁止措置に対し訴訟提起
articles.summary: 米主要メディアがトランプ大統領によるホワイトハウスでの取材禁止措置に対し訴訟を起こした。

articles.title: Millions urged to evacuate as powerful Typhoon Dujuan hits Japan
articles.description: The country's meteorological agency had warned of an "imminent threat to life," but this has now been downgraded in most areas.
articles.titleJa: 強力な台風ドゥージェンが日本を襲い、数百万人に避難勧告
articles.summary: 強力な台風ドゥージェンが日本を直撃し、数百万人に避難勧告が出された。現在はほとんどの地域で警戒が緩和されている。

articles.title: Russia's elections had few surprises - but how the Kremlin uses the results will be crucial
articles.description: Vladimir Putin will likely use the result to claim most Russians back the so-called special military operation in Ukraine, writes the BBC's Steve Rosenberg.
articles.titleJa: ロシアの選挙に驚きは少なかったが、クレムリンが結果をどう利用するかが重要になる
articles.summary: ロシアの選挙結果に大きな驚きはなく、プーチン大統領がウクライナでの「特別軍事作戦」への国民の支持を主張するために結果を利用する見込みだ。

articles.title: Seven Ethiopian rebel groups form new alliance
articles.description: The groups have been active in Ethiopia's most populous regions for years and now say they will work together.
articles.titleJa: エチオピアの反政府勢力7団体が新同盟を結成
articles.summary: エチオピアの主要地域で活動してきた7つの反政府勢力が新たな同盟を結成し、協力体制を構築すると発表した。

articles.title: Xhaka under investigation over Covid-19 certificate
articles.description: Switzerland captain Granit Xhaka is being investigated over an issue with his Covid-19 vaccination certificate.
articles.titleJa: ジャカ選手、新型コロナワクチン証明書を巡り調査対象に
articles.summary: スイス代表主将グラニト・ジャカ選手が、新型コロナウイルスワクチン接種証明書の問題で調査を受けている。

articles.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats could be crimes against humanity, says UN
articles.description: A report says the attacks, of which there have been at least 68, were not self-defence.
articles.titleJa: 米国による麻薬密輸船への攻撃は人道に対する罪にあたる可能性、と国連が指摘
articles.summary: 米国が麻薬密輸船に行った攻撃が、国連の報告書によって「人道に対する罪」にあたる可能性があると指摘された。

articles.title: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption in UK
articles.description: Airlines are angry about the delays, with EasyJet saying the latest incident "once again calls into question the resilience" of the system.
articles.titleJa: 英国で再び管制システム障害、航空各社が批判
articles.summary: 英国で航空管制システムに2度目の不具合が発生し、航空各社が遅延に怒りを表明。システムの信頼性に疑問を呈した。

articles.title: Three held over woman's murder as South Africa police investigate eight other body finds
articles.description: The body of Jabulile Ntimba was the ninth to be found recently in an area east of Johannesburg.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカ、女性殺害で3人拘束、警察は他に8つの遺体発見を捜査
articles.summary: ヨハネスブルグ東部で最近発見された9番目の遺体であるジャブリレ・ンティムバさんの殺害で3人が拘束され、警察は他の8つの遺体発見も捜査している。

articles.title: Nuclear power is back on Southeast Asia's energy agenda
articles.description: Rising electricity demand, shocks in energy security and climate commitments are reviving long-stalled plans for nuclear power across Southeast Asia. But proponents of nuclear energy still face formidable obstacles.
articles.titleJa: 東南アジアで原子力発電がエネルギー課題として再浮上
articles.summary: 電力需要の増加、エネルギー安全保障の懸念、気候変動対策から、東南アジア各国で原子力発電導入計画が再燃している。しかし、依然として多くの課題が残る。

articles.title: Why gender-based violence persists in Southern Africa
articles.description: A series of killings in South Africa has renewed scrutiny of efforts to combat violence against women. Activists say laws alone are not enough without effective implementation.
articles.titleJa: 南部アフリカでジェンダーに基づく暴力が根強く残る理由
articles.summary: 南アフリカでの一連の殺人事件が女性への暴力対策を再検討するきっかけに。活動家は、法律だけでは不十分で、効果的な実施が必要だと主張する。

articles.title: As US and China talk, middle powers jostle for position
articles.description: China's Xi Jinping is traveling to Washington this week. Regardless of what comes from his talks with US President Trump, the EU will likely remain stuck between erratic US trade policy and Beijing's export machine.
articles.titleJa: 米中対話の中、中堅国が立ち位置を模索
articles.summary: 習近平がワシントンを訪問。米中首脳会談の結果にかかわらず、EUは米国の予測不能な貿易政策と中国の輸出攻勢の間で板挟みになる可能性が高い。

articles.title: India's road rage: When cars become weapons
articles.description: Road disputes are turning violent across India, raising questions about status and impunity behind the wheel for drivers of expensive cars.
articles.titleJa: インドのロードレイジ：車が凶器となる時
articles.summary: インド全土で道路上の口論が暴力事件に発展しており、高価な車の運転手の地位と無責任な行為について問題提起されている。

articles.title: Russia: Putin party retains majority in controlled parliamentary vote
articles.description: Vladimir Putin's United Russia won just under 58% of the vote, the electoral commission said. Meanwhile, Putin ally Ramzan Kadyrov won nearly 100% of the vote in elections in the Russian republic of Chechnya.
articles.titleJa: ロシア：プーチン党、管理された議会選挙で過半数を維持
articles.summary: ロシアの与党「統一ロシア」が議会選挙で58%弱の票を獲得し過半数を維持。チェチェン共和国ではプーチン氏の盟友カディロフ氏がほぼ100%の票を得た。

articles.title: Germany news: Trial starts of ex-Transport Minister Scheuer
articles.description: Former Transport Minister Andreas Scheuer is being tried for perjury related to a failed car toll scheme. And cherry farmers have brought in a bumper harvest. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: ドイツのニュース：元運輸大臣シャウアー氏の裁判開始
articles.summary: 元運輸大臣アンドレアス・シャウアー氏が、失敗した自動車通行料制度関連の偽証罪で裁判にかけられている。

articles.title: Pakistan says strikes in Afghanistan killed '28 terrorists'
articles.description: The Afghan border provinces of Kunar and Paktika were struck overnight. Pakistan said 28 militants were killed, Afghanistan said three civilians died. This follows soon after an attack on police in Kohat, Pakistan.
articles.titleJa: パキスタン、アフガニスタンでの攻撃で「テロリスト28人」を殺害と発表
articles.summary: パキスタンがアフガニスタン国境の州を空爆し、28人の武装勢力を殺害したと発表。アフガニスタン側は民間人3人の死亡を報告しており、緊張が高まっている。

articles.title: Germany's car crisis: Can the 35-hour workweek survive?
articles.description: German carmakers want employees to work 40 hours instead of the current 35 without extra pay, arguing it would improve competitiveness. Unions strongly oppose the proposal and view it as an attack on workers' rights.
articles.titleJa: ドイツの自動車危機：35時間労働制は存続できるか？
articles.summary: ドイツの自動車メーカーは競争力向上のため、従業員に週40時間労働を提案。労働組合は労働者の権利への攻撃だと強く反発している。

articles.title: US proposes AI safety mechanism in talks with China
articles.description: US Treasury chief Scott Bessent said there had been "successful" talks with China on trade and AI. The talks come amid growing fears that AI could pose an existential threat to humanity.
articles.titleJa: 米国、中国との協議でAI安全メカニズムを提案
articles.summary: 米財務長官が中国との貿易・AI協議が「成功」だったと発言。AIが人類に存亡の危機をもたらす可能性への懸念が高まる中、AI安全メカニズムが提案された。

articles.title: India news: India's medal tally at Asian games rises to six
articles.description: Indian athletes won two bronze and two silver medals on the second day of the Asian Games in Japan. Meanwhile, more bodies were recovered after a flash flood in Kerala. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: インドのニュース：アジア競技大会でのメダル獲得数が6に増加
articles.summary: アジア競技大会2日目、インド選手はメダル6個を獲得した。一方で、ケララ州での鉄砲水によりさらに遺体が回収された。

articles.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
articles.description:
After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millions
No one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane where they were going. The officers in charge would taunt them when they asked, they said. It was only when the seat-back video screens finally showed a map that the 18 migrants worked it out.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 異国の地へ追放：トランプ政権の秘密の強制送還協定
articles.summary: 米国から何千人もの人々が、トランプ政権下の秘密協定により、見知らぬアフリカの国々へ強制送還されている実態が明らかに。

articles.title: Men deported from US bound and beaten in Equatorial Guinea detention hotel, lawyers say
articles.description:
Group trapped at Hotel Bamy after US removal as rights groups sound alarm over poor conditions and violence

Two men that the Trump administration expelled to Equatorial Guinea were bound, fitted with bags over their heads, beaten and pushed down a flight of stairs, all in plain view of other US deportees, according to witnesses and human rights lawyers.
The men – one from Egypt and one from Eritrea – were then taken to a prison. About 30 detainees from the US remain trapped at a hotel in the outskirts of the coastal city of Malabo after being deported from the US. Detainees have said they believe the men were beaten for telling the press and human rights advocates about the poor conditions and violence inside the hotel, and that they are haunted by flashbacks and terrified they will be retaliated against next.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国から強制送還された男性らが赤道ギニアの拘禁ホテルで拘束・暴行されたと弁護士が証言
articles.summary: 米国から赤道ギニアへ強制送還された男性たちが、現地の拘禁ホテルで拘束され暴行を受けていると人権団体が警鐘を鳴らしている。

articles.title: Survivors recount panic and struggle to breathe in Nigerian prison cell where 37 died
articles.description:
Police fire teargas as protests break out in city of Minna after deaths of suspected illegal goldminers, many of whom were children
Survivors from a prison cell in Nigeria where 37 suspected illegal goldminers died while in the custody of a paramilitary group this week have recounted their panic and struggle for breath, as police on Friday fired teargas at people protesting against the deaths and imposed an overnight curfew in the city of Minna.
The victims – many of whom were children – were found dead on Thursday in the cells of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), which had raided suspected illegal goldmines and ⁠locked up dozens of miners in the city, the state capital of the mineral-rich state of Niger.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ナイジェリアの拘置所で37人死亡、生存者が語るパニックと呼吸困難
articles.summary: ナイジェリアの拘置所で37人の不法金採掘容疑者が死亡。生存者は過密な環境でのパニックと呼吸困難を語り、街では抗議デモが発生した。

articles.title: British woman who was kidnapped in Malawi rescued by police after shootout
articles.description:
Four of Nusrat Osman’s alleged abductors were killed during rescue after she was taken from outside her home last week
A British woman kidnapped in Malawi last week has been rescued by police after a shootout in which four of her alleged abductors were killed.
Nusrat Osman was abducted outside her home in the southern city of Blantyre on 11 September at about 12.30pm. Police had offered a reward of 30m Malawi kwacha (£12,950) for information leading to her rescue and the arrest of the perpetrators.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: マラウイで誘拐された英国人女性、銃撃戦の末に警察に救出される
articles.summary: マラウイで誘拐された英国人女性が、警察による銃撃戦の末に救出された。容疑者4人が死亡。

articles.title: Louisiana firefighters find feline native to sub-Saharan Africa while responding to house fire
articles.description:
The African serval, illegally enclosed in the back yard, was subdued and transferred to an animal welfare facility 
Louisiana firefighters responding to a small house blaze found a wildcat native to sub-Saharan Africa illegally enclosed in the back yard, prompting an animal welfare agency to seek placing the creature in an appropriate environment, according to officials.
Firefighters investigating a report of a minor fire at a home in the suburban New Orleans community of Marrero on Tuesday spotted the cat in question – an African serval – behind the residence in a chain-linked enclosure resembling a cramped baseball batting cage, a spokesperson for the local animal protection services said.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ルイジアナ州の消防士、住宅火災対応中にサハラ以南アフリカ原産のネコ科動物を発見
articles.summary: 米国ルイジアナ州で住宅火災に出動した消防士が、裏庭で違法に飼育されていたアフリカ産サーバルを発見し、動物保護施設へ移送された。

articles.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’, UN finds
articles.description:
Dozens of US attacks on boats in the Pacific and Caribbean have killed more than 230 people since September 2025
A special rapporteur for the UN human rights council has concluded that there are “reasonable grounds to believe” that the United States attacks on boats allegedly carrying drugs in the Pacific and Caribbean “constituted crimes against humanity”.
The boat strikes, carried out since September 2025 on the stated grounds of stopping drugs being trafficked by sea to the US, have killed more than 230 people. The latest, on Saturday, killed four people in the Caribbean.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国の麻薬密輸船への攻撃は「人道に対する罪」に当たる可能性、国連が指摘
articles.summary: 国連は、米国が麻薬密輸船への攻撃で230人以上を殺害したことが、「人道に対する罪」に当たる可能性があると指摘した。

articles.title: Man and police officer wounded in exchange of gunfire near Ontario synagogue
articles.description:
Officials say man was critically injured and officer was wounded in Yom Kippur incident near Belleville synagogue
A police officer and a man were wounded in an exchange of gunfire on Sunday near a synagogue in Ontario as members of the Jewish community marked Yom Kippur, authorities said. The man was hospitalized in life-threatening condition.
The Canadian province’s special investigations unit said the exchange of gunfire happened near the Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville, Ontario, about 110 miles (160km) east of Toronto. Belleville police said the officer encountered the man at about 7.10pm and that both were taken to a hospital.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: オンタリオ州のシナゴーグ付近で銃撃戦、男性と警察官が負傷
articles.summary: カナダのオンタリオ州ベルビルにあるシナゴーグ付近で銃撃戦が発生し、男性と警察官が負傷した。ユダヤ教のヨム・キプール中に起きた。

articles.title: Macron and Carney announce closer France-Canada ties amid Trump tensions
articles.description:
Two leaders meet in French territory off Canada as Ottawa seeks stronger relations with EU while fighting trade war with US
The leaders of France and Canada have pledged closer ties to grapple with rising geopolitical tensions, climate change and the erosion of democratic values, after ⁠they met in a ⁠French territory off Canada’s Atlantic coast.
The two leaders’ visit to Saint-Pierre ​and Miquelon – the first by a French president since 2014 and the first by a Canadian prime minister – came just weeks ⁠after Donald Trump posted an image showing the islands, as well as all of Canada and other countries in North America, covered by the US flag.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: マクロン仏大統領とカーニー加首相、トランプ政権との緊張の中、仏加の緊密な関係を発表
articles.summary: カナダ沖の仏領で仏加首脳が会談し、トランプ政権との緊張を背景に、気候変動対策や民主的価値保護のため連携強化を表明した。

articles.title: More than a dozen arrested in connection with 2021 assassination of Haitian president
articles.description:
Jovenel Moïse, 53, was shot dead in July 2021 in a killing which sparked chaos in Haiti
Eighteen people have been arrested in association with the 2021 assassination of the Haitian president Jovenel Moïse, according to US officials.
Moïse, 53, was shot dead on 7 July 2021 at his private residence by a hired group of about 20 military-trained Colombian mercenaries. His security detail did not intervene to protect him.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ハイチ大統領暗殺事件で12人以上を逮捕
articles.summary: 2021年に発生したハイチのジョブネル・モイーズ大統領暗殺事件に関与したとして、18人が逮捕された。事件はハイチに混乱をもたらした。

articles.title: Michelle Bachelet withdraws from race to become UN secretary general
articles.description:
Former president of Chile drops out after support collapsed in security council straw poll, leaving seven candidates in contest
Michelle Bachelet, a former president of Chile, has withdrawn her candidacy to become the next secretary general of the ⁠UN, ending an attempt ​that had struggled to gain traction among security council members.
Bachelet, 74, announced ⁠her decision in a video posted on Instagram on Saturday, saying: “I will now continue, with the ⁠same determination as always, my international work.”
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ミシェル・バチェレ氏、国連事務総長選からの立候補を撤回
articles.summary: チリ元大統領のミシェル・バチェレ氏が、国連事務総長選への立候補を撤回した。安全保障理事会の予備投票で支持が伸び悩んだため。

articles.title: EU moves to curb energy and water for data centres
articles.description: The European Commission has unveiled new sustainability rules aimed at monitoring water and energy consumption of energy-hungry data centres - although minimum performance rules will only be introduced in 2027.
articles.titleJa: EU、データセンターのエネルギーと水消費抑制へ
articles.summary: 欧州委員会は、エネルギーを大量消費するデータセンターの持続可能性に関する新規則を発表。水とエネルギー消費の監視を目的とし、最低性能規則は2027年に導入予定。

articles.title: What is CETA – and why is the EU-Canada trade deal still in limbo?
articles.description: The EU-Canada trade deal has been provisionally in force since 2017, but ten EU countries have still not ratified it. What is CETA – and why, a decade after it was signed, is it still in limbo?
articles.titleJa: CETAとは何か？EU・カナダ貿易協定が宙に浮いたままの理由
articles.summary: EU・カナダ貿易協定CETAは2017年から暫定的に発効中だが、EU加盟10カ国が未批准。署名から10年経っても不透明な状況が続く。

articles.title: EU sends experts to Congo as Ebola outbreak continues; Congo receives vaccines for clinical trials
articles.description: Two European epidemiologists are going to the epicentre of the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. In the meantime, clinical trials of the Ervebo vaccine kick off.
articles.titleJa: EUがコンゴに専門家派遣、エボラ出血熱流行続く中ワクチン治験開始
articles.summary: EUは、エボラ出血熱が流行するコンゴ民主共和国に疫学者を派遣。同時に、Erveboワクチンの臨床試験が開始された。

articles.title: Former Romanian presidential candidate Georgescu detained and put under investigation for fraud
articles.description: Prosecutors say Georgescu and two others persuaded a Romanian businessman to transfer them €1.1 million by making him believe he could get access to millions of euros worth of foreign bank financing.
articles.titleJa: ルーマニア元大統領候補ゲオルゲスク、詐欺容疑で拘束・捜査対象に
articles.summary: ルーマニアの検察当局は、元大統領候補のゲオルゲスク氏が外国人ビジネスマンを騙し、110万ユーロを不正に送金させた疑いで捜査を開始した。

articles.title: Removing Usmanov from sanctions list risks making EU look weak - Lithuanian finance minister
articles.description: Vilnius strongly opposes France's push to remove Usmanov from Russian sanctions, its finance minister told Euronews. However, fears of the blacklist expiring will likely lead to his removal despite heavy backlash.
articles.titleJa: ウスマノフ氏の制裁リスト除外はEUを弱体化させるリスク ― リトアニア財務相
articles.summary: リトアニアの財務相は、フランスがロシアのウスマノフ氏を制裁リストから除外しようとしていることに強く反対。EUの信用失墜につながる可能性を指摘した。

articles.title: EU countries issued a record 3.9 million residence permits last year
articles.description: EU countries issued a record number of residence permits in 2025, up 10% on the year, driven mainly by employment and family reunification.
articles.titleJa: EU諸国、昨年は過去最高の390万件の居住許可を発行
articles.summary: EU諸国は昨年、主に雇用と家族再統合を理由に、過去最高の390万件の居住許可を発行。前年比10%増を記録した。

articles.title: Kallas urges EU countries to bolster Red Sea mission as Houthi threats mount
articles.description: The EU is considering reinforcing Operation Aspides in the Red Sea, after Italy's request, with ships and aircraft to protect the Bab el-Mandeb Strait from attacks launched from Yemen. The passage is crucial for energy trade, as energy costs are skyrocketing across Europe.
articles.titleJa: カラス首相、フーシ派の脅威増大で紅海ミッション強化をEU諸国に要請
articles.summary: フーシ派の脅威増大を受け、EUは紅海での「アスピデス作戦」の強化を検討。エネルギー貿易の要衝であるバブ・エル・マンデブ海峡を防衛し、高騰するエネルギー価格への影響を軽減する狙いがある。

articles.title: How fake Naxos potatoes and modern ambitions are threatening the future of a world-renowned crop
articles.description: Historic Naxos potatoes hold protected status, but young people on the island no longer want to be farmers.
articles.titleJa: 偽ナクソス産ジャガイモと現代の野心が、世界的に有名な作物の未来を脅かす
articles.summary: ギリシャのナクソス島で、保護対象の歴史あるナクソス産ジャガイモが危機に瀕している。偽造品問題に加え、島の若者が農業を敬遠し、後継者不足が深刻化している。

articles.title: Ireland backs 'ambitious' new EU taxes as budget talks intensify

articles.summary: WTO事務局は、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割に関する新たな報告書を発表。国境を越えた決済を加速し、途上国の貿易参加を促進する機会と課題を検討。

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds
articles.description: Global goods trade continued to strengthen in mid-2026 despite persistent geopolitical and policy-related uncertainties, according to the WTO Goods Trade Barometer released on 9 September 2026.
articles.titleJa: 物品貿易バロメーター、逆風にもかかわらず堅調な貿易成長を示す
articles.summary: WTO物品貿易バロメーターによると、2026年半ばにかけて、地政学的な不確実性にもかかわらず、世界の物品貿易は引き続き堅調に推移している。

articles.title: WTO issues 2026 Annual Report
articles.description: The WTO published today (9 September) its 2026 Annual Report, providing a comprehensive account of the organization’s activities in 2025 and the early part of 2026. The Report looks back at recent key events, such as the 14th Ministerial Conference in March 2026, and describes the WTO's work in addressing the challenges and opportunities facing world trade.
articles.titleJa: WTOが2026年年次報告書を発表
articles.summary: WTOは2026年年次報告書を公表し、2025年から2026年初頭にかけての活動を包括的に説明。第14回閣僚会議などの主要な出来事を振り返った。

articles.title: New report highlights growth potential of digital trade in Latin America, Caribbean
articles.description: A new report by the WTO Secretariat, the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) and the World Bank examines how digital trade is transforming the way Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) economies connect to international markets and identifies opportunities to unlock further growth, inclusion and development for the region.
articles.titleJa: 新報告書、ラテンアメリカ・カリブ海地域のデジタル貿易の成長可能性を強調
articles.summary: WTO、米州開発銀行、世界銀行の新たな報告書が、中南米・カリブ海諸国におけるデジタル貿易の成長と発展の可能性、および国際市場への接続方法の変化を検証。
